cards.title: Functions use other tools
cards.body: Inside a function you can use any built-in tool: `split()`, `len()`, `max()` and the rest.

cards.title: len() works on lists
cards.body: `len()` counts the items in a list, so you can count the pieces after splitting. `split(",")` cuts at commas instead of spaces.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: split() gives 4 words, and len() counts them.

exercise.prompt: Write `word_count(text)` that returns how many words the text has (words are separated by spaces). Read a line and print `word_count` of it.
